tools.name: quote_fax
tools.description: Price a fax before committing to anything. Validates the destination and the document, counts pages, and returns an exact total plus a payment link. Free, and sends nothing. Always call this before send_fax.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Returns the authorization instructions for sending a previously quoted fax. THIS ACTION COSTS MONEY AND CANNOT BE UNDONE: paying the returned link transmits a real document to a real fax machine. tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Current delivery state of a fax: awaiting_payment, paid, submitted, sending, delivered, or failed. Failed faxes include a reason you can act on.

tools.name: get_fax_receipt
tools.description: Verifiable delivery receipt for a completed fax. Available once the fax has reached a final state. Use this to prove the workflow finished.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_fax" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
